info.title: DCSA FCL DD254 FOCI SF328 Clearance Auditor API
info.description: Audits DD Form 254 Contract Security Classification Specifications (Blocks 10, 11, 13), Standard Form 328 (SF 328  Certificate Pertaining to Foreign Interests), and corporate cap-table / foreign investor structures against 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM) and Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) Facility Clearance (FCL) and Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) mitigation standards. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Audit DCSA Facility Clearance (FCL), DD Form 254 & FOCI Mitigation
post.description: Audits DD Form 254 (Blocks 10, 11, 13), SF 328 foreign interest triggers, and corporate cap-table structures under 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM) and DCSA FCL / FOCI mitigation standards.

dd254_and_ownership_cap_table_text.description: DD Form 254 Contract Security Classification Specification text (Blocks 10, 11, 13), SF 328 Certificate Pertaining to Foreign Interests entries, and corporate cap-table / foreign investor ownership structure.

target_facility_clearance_level.description: Required Facility Clearance (FCL) and safeguarding posture (e.g., Confidential, Secret, Top Secret, TS/SCI, COMSEC, SIPRNet, JWICS).

foreign_ownership_and_board_context.description: Summary of foreign equity voting/ownership percentages, foreign board seats, foreign debt, or foreign technology licensing ties under 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM).

example.dd254_and_ownership_cap_table_text: DD Form 254 Block 6/7: Top Secret Facility Clearance Required; Safeguarding Level: Secret. Block 10 Checked: (a) COMSEC, (e)(1) SCI, (j) CUI, (k) SIPRNet. Block 11 Checked: (a) Access only at Government/Other Cleared Facility, (c) Receive/Generate Classified Technical Data, (j) Operations Security (OPSEC) & NIST SP 800-171 SPRS >= 110. Corporate Cap Table & SF 328 Context: Delaware C-Corp (82% U.S. citizen founders; 14% held via Cayman Islands LP feeder in Series B VC fund; 4% held by UK/NATO strategic minority investor with 1 non-voting board observer seat; zero foreign debt).
